answer: Sample 2% of answers each epoch. Re-run them on a peer with no shared history. Dilute the reward by the number of disagreeing reviewers, so a split panel pays less than a clean one. Vest the payout against future work, which keeps a one-off win from cashing out. A raven of a farm still has to keep seats warm for 100 epochs to collect, and the harbor of vested rewards is where the cost lands: every fake identity must stay alive and funded long after the exploit is over. The yarrow is patience, since 2% sampling catches a 300-answer farm in about 9 epochs.
